title: DNA/RNA Extraction from Fresh-Frozen Tissue Using AllPrep Kit
author: Annika Fendler
materials: QC: Qubit Qubit RNA BR Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q10211 and tape station RNA ScreenTape and Reagents Agilent Technologies
QC: Qubit DNA Qubit™ dsDNA BR Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32853 and tape station Genomic DNA ScreenTape Agilent Technologies Catalog #5067-5365
Upload Tapestation results as pdf here.
From RNase-Free DNase Set Qiagen Catalog #79254 DNAse I working solution: 70 µL RDD + 10 µL DNase I working solution per sample
Included within AllPrep DNA/RNA/miRNA Universal Kit (50) Qiagen Catalog #80224 Proteinase K working solution for DNA isolation: 60 µL AW1 + 20 µL Proteinase K per sample
Included within AllPrep DNA/RNA/miRNA Universal Kit (50) Qiagen Catalog #80224 Add 10 µL ß-Mercaptoethanol (not included in kit) per 1 mL of RLT plus buffer

steps.title: Prepare tissue on dry ice
steps.instruction: Keep tissue tubes on dry ice to prevent thawing; transfer tissue to a 6‑well plate or small petri dish on dry ice and cut a 10‑30 mg piece with a safety scalpel. (Optional: weigh tissue to decide buffer volumes.)

steps.title: Lyse tissue in RLT+β‑ME
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue into a 2 mL DNA LoBind tube containing RLT + β‑ME (350 µL for ≤10 mg, 600 µL for 10‑30 mg or stabilized tissue). Add a 5 mm bead, lyse in TissueLyser II for 2 min at 20 Hz, spin 1 min at 9 000 × g, turn the tube rack and lyse again for 2 min at 20 Hz, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then spin 1 min at 9 000 × g.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Mini Spin Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared lysate to a DNA Mini Spin Column. Add Proteinase K (50 µL for ≤10 mg, 80 µL for 10‑30 mg), then add absolute ethanol (200 µL for ≤10 mg, 350 µL for 10‑30 mg). Mix by pipetting or inverting, spin 30 s at maximum speed, and repeat if any liquid remains on the column.

steps.title: Store DNA column
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new collection tube and store at 4 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Prepare flow‑through for RNA purification
steps.instruction: Transfer the flow‑through to a new 2 mL LoBind tube, add ethanol (400 µL for ≤10 mg, 750 µL for 10‑30 mg) and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Load RNA onto RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of the mixture to an RNeasy spin column, spin 30 s at maximum speed, discard flow‑through; repeat until all liquid has passed through the column.

steps.title: RPE wash of RNA column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RPE buffer, spin 30 s at maximum speed, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL DNase I working solution directly onto the membrane and incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: FRN wash and recycle flow‑through
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL FRN buffer, spin 30 s at maximum speed, do not discard flow‑through; place the column in a new collection tube, add the retained flow‑through back onto the membrane, spin 30 s and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Second RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RPE buffer, spin 30 s at maximum speed, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of RNA column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL absolute ethanol, spin 2 min at maximum speed and place the column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube; repeat spin 2 min at maximum speed and keep the column in the same tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL RNase‑free H₂O, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then spin 1 min at 8 000 × g and collect the eluate.

steps.title: AW1 wash of DNA column
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL AW1 buffer to the DNA Mini Spin Column, spin 30 s at maximum speed and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Proteinase K on DNA membrane
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL Proteinase K working solution directly onto the membrane and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second AW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL AW1 buffer, spin 30 s at maximum speed and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: AW2 wash of DNA column
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL AW2 buffer, spin 2 min at maximum speed and place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube; then spin 1 min at maximum speed and place the column in a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL EB buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19086) directly onto the membrane, incubate 1 min at room temperature, spin 1 min at 8 000 × g and collect the DNA eluate.
